cases.title: Did the win-back email actually lift retention?
cases.blurb: Marketing swears the Q3 win-back email lifted 90-day retention by 30 points. You've got the user-level export. Is the lift real, or is something else going on?

cases.title: Do support tickets cause churn — should we cut the team?
cases.blurb: Accounts that contact support churn far more, so the COO wants to cut the support team to save money and reduce churn. Does the data actually support that?

cases.title: The new checkout converts worse overall — roll it back?
cases.blurb: The redesigned checkout converts lower than the old one overall, and the Head of Growth wants to roll it back. Split the data before she does.

cases.title: Team A's win rate beats Team B — is B underperforming?
cases.blurb: Team A closes 37% of deals, Team B only 30%, and the VP wants to reshuffle B. Compare the pods fairly before anyone gets moved.
